items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he played with her here in Denver, in '73.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don't know whether she loved me or not, but when I first moved out here in '73, and she played her, well, they sent me a telegram, calling me.

Yes, he played with her here in Denver, in '73. And I could have stayed with her, but I was playing with the World's Greatest Jazz Band at the time, which I should have stayed with her, because I went out and made four weeks with it, on the road.
